item.title: Twenty Five Ships From Seven German Companies Stranded in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: At least 25 ships from seven German maritime companies, including two cruise ships carrying about 7,000 passengers, are stranded in Gulf waters and cannot leave through the Strait of Hormuz for security reasons, Germany's shipowners' association VDR said on Monday without naming the companies.

item.title: Sugar Prices Rise Ahead of Iran War Fears
item.description: World sugar prices headed higher on Monday on fears the U.S.-Israel war against Iran, which is disrupting global energy supplies, will prompt Brazilian cane mills to produce more ethanol and less sugar.Ethanol is a cane-based biofuel.

item.title: China Oil Refiners Feel Safe From Iran Conflict Disruption with Crude Stockpile
item.description: Refiners in China, the world's top oil importer, have enough supply on hand to weather near-term disruption from the Iran conflict, bolstered by recent record purchases of Iranian and Russian crude and robust government stockpiling, traders said.A prolonged supply disruption could…

item.title: Venture Global is ready to meet the LNG shortage as Qatar stops production
item.description: Mike Sabel, CEO of Venture Global, said that the company has the largest amount of LNG cargoes in the world that are not contracted and is prepared to stabilize global markets when Qatar stops production due to attacks by Iran.Qatari LNG production equals about 20% of global supply.
